notes: Source status strings are static base definitions. list_dataset_sources performs additional configuration checks.
Emitted-schema columns are reviewed fixture vocabulary, not an exhaustive provider API schema or proof every sync returns every column.
source_paths are ordered alternatives where applicable; do not select every alias or infer missing values.
Receipt contract groups identify printed-measure alternatives; curated numeric, currency, objective, condition and fixture checks still apply.
Historical version identities are indexed here; historical bodies remain in metric_policy.py.
A source_expression object records AST that was deliberately not executed; it is not a computed runtime value.
Provider evidence URLs were copied from repository contracts, not newly checked for this handoff.
API-version lists are fixture-declared compatibility checks, not provider support lifetime guarantees.

snapshot.scope: Code contracts, not live credentials, live availability, full provider payloads, or a new external provider audit.

verification.extraction: AST for source/OAuth definitions; pure policy-module imports for built registry; no app.main bootstrap or live configuration lookup.
